title: krn pr ship exits non-zero unless the PR merged, and a rerun after merge only cleans up
body:
Why: logic audit: src/ci/wait.ts:119-122,178-187 return 'not merging', 'closed unmerged' and 'blocked' as normal verdicts so ship exits 0 without a merge; src/ci/ship.ts:101-147 a rerun after a merged PR with failed cleanup hits 'No commits between' before cleanup, and a failed worktree remove after merge (:179) exits non-zero.
Outcome: exit 0 means merged; every other verdict has its own non-zero code; a rerun detects the merged PR and only cleans up.
Proof: strict-gh tests for each verdict and for rerun-after-merge.
Scope: src/ci/, test/ci/.
